list.openHint: Opens the team's squad and settings.

create.title: Create a team
create.subtitle: Name your team. You become the captain and add players later with an invite link.
create.name: Team name
create.districtFromProfile: The team is created in the district set in your profile.
create.noDistrict: To create a team, first choose your district in your profile.
create.unverified: Verify your email address to create a team. Tap the verification link in your inbox.

validation.nameTooShort: The team name needs at least {{min}} characters.
validation.nameTooLong: The team name can have at most {{max}} characters.
validation.nameInvalid: The team name cannot contain invisible characters.

join.title: Join a team
join.subtitle: Paste the invite link or the invite code a friend sent you.
join.inputInvalid: This is not an invite link or code. Paste the whole link.

invite.title: Team invite
invite.acceptHint: You join the team as a player.
invite.invalidMessage: This invite has expired, has no uses left or was cancelled by the captain. Ask the captain for a new link.
invite.alreadyMember: You are already on this team.
invite.unverified: Verify your email address to join a team.

detail.locked: This team is read-only: the Pro plan has ended, so no new invites or matches can be created.
detail.leaveQuestion: Are you sure you want to leave {{team}}? You will need a new invite to join again.
detail.captainCannotLeave: The captain cannot leave the team. Hand the captaincy to another player first.
detail.missingMessage: This team was deleted or you are no longer a member.

member.transferQuestion: Are you sure you want to make {{name}} the captain? You become a co-captain.
member.noActions: There is nothing you can change for this player.
member.missingMessage: This player is no longer on the team.

invites.title: Invite players
invites.intro: Share the link or let them scan the QR code. Anyone who opens the link can join the team as a player.
invites.onceNotice: This code is shown only now. You cannot see it again after leaving this screen; create a new link if needed.
invites.qrLabel: QR code of the invite link
invites.shareFailed: The share sheet could not open. You can select and copy the code on screen.
invites.revokeQuestion: Cancel this invite? The link stops working at once.
invites.locked: This team is read-only, so no new invites can be created.
invites.unverified: Verify your email address to create invites.
invites.staffOnly: Only the captain and co-captains manage invites.
